title: Human-authored correction
description: A reviewed, committed correction over pipeline output (corrections/<record-id>.yml). Keyed by record id; records who/when/why + evidence so every correction is auditable. Applied by pipeline.corrections AFTER extraction and BEFORE the final sanitize, so an overridden value still passes every gate. overrides can never set a forbidden PII field, id, or minor_involved (dropped by the loader).

record_id.description: The id of the record this correction applies to.

quarantine.description: true routes the record out of the published site into _review.

overrides.description: Field-level overrides applied to the record before sanitize. Keys targeting a forbidden PII field, id, or minor_involved are ignored.

evidence.description: Citations the correction relies on (URLs, order numbers).
